meetingNotes.intro: These notes were made with AI from the meeting recording. Check them before sharing.
meetingNotes.cut: The transcript was shortened here because it is long.

act.proposed: The actions I prepared are waiting for your approval.
act.nothing: I could not find an action I can do for this. Could you be more specific?
act.unknownPerson: I could not find a person called "{name}".
act.unknownBoard: I could not find the board "{board}".
act.badTime: I could not read the time "{time}", or it is in the past.
act.noTodoCard: There is no to-do card on your home page. Add one to your home page first.
act.unknownTodoCard: I could not find a to-do card named "{card}".
act.whichTodoCard: Which to-do card should I add it to? Your cards: {cards}.
act.moduleOff: The module this needs is turned off in your organisation.
act.unknownConversation: I could not find a person or a conversation you can write in named "{name}".
act.unknownSpace: I could not find a space named "{name}".
act.unknownPage: I could not find a page titled "{name}".
act.nothingToRead: There are no messages to read in "{name}".
act.proposedN: {n} action(s) prepared and waiting for your approval. Nothing has changed yet.
act.notPrepared: There is nothing I can prepare right now:
act.nothingDone: Nothing has changed yet. Could you say a little more clearly what you need?
act.approving: Got your approval, applying it now.
act.rejecting: All right, cancelling what I prepared.
act.noTasks: I found no tasks to take from the "{name}" conversation.
act.whichTodoCardFrom: From which to-do card? Your cards: {cards}.
act.emptyTodoCard: There are no open items to carry on "{card}", so I prepared nothing.
act.emptyPage: There is nothing to turn into items on the "{name}" page, so I prepared nothing.
act.whichPage: There are several pages called "{name}": {pages}. Which one do you mean?
act.notAConversation: "{name}" is a page, so I cannot message it. Tell me if I should add a note to the page.
act.alreadyOnCard: These items are all on "{card}" already.
act.todoFull: This does not fit on "{card}": a card takes at most {max} items.
act.tooManyItems: The "{name}" page has {n} items; I can carry at most {max} at once.
act.noSuchItems: I could not find these items on "{card}".
